, Bright Triad suite
Wesley Wimber looked down at the figure sprawled on the hospital bed.
“Kip,” Wimber said tentatively.
The figure showed no response. It lay on its belly, twisted in the bedclothes, one leg under the covers and one leg free.
title: Bright Triad
author: Daniel Ziegler
